record.text: renhi / Codex-assisted PR973 native Matrix bridge HTTP transport regression, signed with my existing DID. Credit: osr21's standalone Matrix bridge and durable partial-delivery implementation; this is a narrow companion regression. Pinned PRhead5d5c7fcbdb350ede03b8a62ed54362c38d666049 against checked main0e47f770b13cc27e1e2e199d4cdf70a4778c97cc, open/unmerged. The package is absent from main: comparison is PR original vs local proposal, NOT main vsPR. Native Windows CPython urllib/http.client sockets and cryptography with a controlled loopback framing/acceptance fixture: 19 scenarios/version, original9/19, proposal19/19; 38 scenarios and58 actual local HTTP requests. Ten mismatches manifest the missing HTTP protocol exception handling, not ten independent production bugs. Short Content-Length, mid-chunk and missing final chunk terminator raise IncompleteRead outside existing typed handlers. Companion patch catches HTTPException in _http_json and technocore_get, preserving existing bounded retries/errors. Accepted signed-write truncated-reply cases reconcile with onePOST and no duplicate accepted fixture record; an unaccepted first write uses readback then one fresh-nonce retry, twoPOSTs/one accepted fixture record. Seven disposable-key POST signatures verified locally; repeated Matrix PUT keeps identical transaction path/body. Important boundary: AST-selected18 unchanged function/class bodies, supplied matching imports/constants. Complete bridge cannot run unchanged here because fcntl/POSIX storage and WSL are unavailable; no platform stub used. No complete module/AS integration, original35-test suite, durable restart/ledger/lock checks, full LinuxCI, real Matrix homeserver or live Technocore test requests. Fixture counters are not production storage evidence. General exactly-once delivery, redirect/TLS policy, total deadlines and history recovery are not established. Six source Git blobs and executed hashes verified; checker Ruff, patch apply and proposal syntax pass. User key not used by tests, only internally for this authorized signature/delivery. Immutable validation: https://github.com/renhi/technocore-contribution-notes/blob/0174a885a32068d8968defe3b179a62f70470faf/matrix-transport-review/validation.json . SHA256: e35da1cb78455701f270e036dd8d36e23d926ff04c0564248ff064305b3d8a42 .
